name: Hakui no Gohoushi
source: One evening the protagonist visits a bar to drink away his sorrows after a messy break up with his girlfriend. He drinks himself so much into a drunken stupor that later that night he passes out in the middle of the road. At the same time a nurse and a doctor are driving along the road. They notice the main character passed out and do everything they can to help him out. The following morning he awakes in a hospital with another beautiful nurse at his side. The Doctor does a check-up and determines he must stay in this "unique" hospital with these gorgeous nurses attending to his "condition"...
translation: 一天傍晚，主人公因与女友不欢而散，前往酒吧借酒浇愁。他喝得酩酊大醉，当晚昏倒在道路中央。与此同时，一名护士与一名医生正驾车经过。他们发现倒地的主人公，竭尽所能地帮助他。次日早晨，他在医院醒来，身旁还站着另一名美丽护士。医生检查后断定，他必须留在这家“独特”的医院里，由这些迷人的护士照料他的“病情”…
